name: Pertamina Enduro
description: Performance-engineered lubricants for ultimate engine protection.
story: Pertamina Enduro is the lubricant division of Indonesia's state-owned oil and gas company. They have a long history of supporting motorsport in the Southeast Asian region, seeking to showcase the reliability and performance of their products under extreme conditions. Pertamina Enduro wants to partner with teams and drivers who demonstrate dedication and push the boundaries of performance.
